items.source: Name of the attribute containing the resolved and parsed API version.
items.translation: 包含已解析和解析的 API 版本的 `attribute` 名称。

items.source: Name of the attribute that contains the mapped handler for the best matching pattern.
items.translation: 包含最佳匹配模式映射处理器的 `attribute` 名称。

items.source: Name of the attribute that contains the best matching pattern within the handler mapping.
items.translation: 包含处理器映射中最佳匹配模式的 `attribute` 名称。

items.source:
Note: This attribute is not required to be supported by all
HandlerMapping implementations. URL-based HandlerMappings will
typically support it but handlers should not necessarily expect
this request attribute to be present in all scenarios.
items.translation: 注意：并非所有 `HandlerMapping` 实现都必须支持此属性。基于 URL 的 `HandlerMapping` 通常支持它，但处理器不应期望在所有场景下都存在此请求属性。

items.source:
Note: This attribute is not required to be supported by all
HandlerMapping implementations. URL-based HandlerMappings will
typically support it, but handlers should not necessarily expect
this request attribute to be present in all scenarios.
items.translation: 注意：并非所有 `HandlerMapping` 实现都必须支持此属性。基于 URL 的 `HandlerMapping` 通常支持它，但处理器不应期望在所有场景下都存在此请求属性。

items.source:
Note: This attribute is not required to be supported by all
HandlerMapping implementations and may also not be present depending on
whether the HandlerMapping is configured to keep matrix variable content
in the request URI.
items.translation: 注意：此属性并非所有 `HandlerMapping` 实现都必须支持，并且根据 `HandlerMapping` 是否配置为在请求 URI 中保留矩阵变量内容，该属性也可能不存在。

items.source:
Note: This attribute is not required to be supported by all
HandlerMapping implementations. Handlers should not necessarily expect
this request attribute to be present in all scenarios.
items.translation: 注意：并非所有 HandlerMapping 实现都必须支持此属性。处理器不应期望在所有场景下都存在此请求属性。

items.source:
Before returning a handler, an implementing method should check for
CORS configuration associated with the handler, apply validation checks
based on it, and update the response accordingly. For pre-flight requests,
the same should be done based on the handler matching to the expected
actual request.
items.translation: 在返回处理器之前，实现方法应检查与该处理器关联的 CORS 配置，应用基于该配置的验证检查，并相应地更新响应。对于预检请求，也应根据处理器与预期实际请求的匹配情况执行相同的操作。

items.source: Name of the attribute that contains the path within the handler mapping, in case of a pattern match such as "/static/**" or the full relevant URI otherwise.
items.translation: 包含处理器映射中路径的 `attribute` 名称，如果是模式匹配（如 `"/static/**"`），则为该路径；否则为完整的有关联的 URI。

items.source: Name of the attribute that contains a map with URI variable names and a corresponding MultiValueMap of URI matrix variables for each.
items.translation: 包含一个映射的 `attribute` 名称，该映射将 URI 变量名与每个变量对应的 URI 矩阵变量的 `MultiValueMap` 关联起来。

items.source: Name of the attribute containing the set of producible MediaType's applicable to the mapped handler.
items.translation: 包含适用于已映射处理器的可生成 MediaType 集合的 `attribute` 名称。

items.source: Name of the attribute that contains the URI templates map mapping variable names to values.
items.translation: 包含将变量名映射到值的 URI 模板图的 `attribute` 名称。

items.source: a Mono that emits one value or none in case the request cannot be resolved to a handler
items.translation: 一个在请求无法解析为处理器时发出一个值或无值的 `Mono`。

items.source:
Interface to be implemented by objects that define a mapping between
requests and handler objects.
items.translation: 由定义请求与处理程序对象之间映射的对象所实现的接口。

items.source: Return a handler for this request.
items.translation: 返回该请求的处理程序。
